title: PAK vs HK: What's Happening in the Quarterfinals
seoTitle: PAK vs HK: T20I Quarterfinal Preview
subtitle: The clash between Pakistan and Hong Kong promises excitement in the T20I
excerpt: Pakistan faces Hong Kong in the T20I quarterfinals at the 2026 Asian Games, with both teams eyeing a spot in the semifinals.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Pakistan and Hong Kong face off in the T20I quarterfinals at the 2026 Asian Games, in a clash that promises to reveal who will advance to the semifinal stage. The match, scheduled for September 28, is drawing attention due to the lineups and players who could change the course of the game.

Pakistan: Form and key players

Pakistan occupies the 6th position in the ICC Men's T20I Team Rankings with 240 points. The team has average form in T20s, having only reached the Super 8 in the last T20 World Cup. Captain Sahibzada Farhan, in the form of his life in this format, leads the team. Among the highlights are Maaz Sadaqat, who shone in the Caribbean Premier League, and Sufyan Moqim, a bubble improver who can make things difficult for the opponents' attack.

Hong Kong: Recent performance and key attackers

Hong Kong finished in 2nd place in their group and advanced to the quarterfinals. The tournament's top run-scorer is Shiv Mathur, with 41 runs, and the best wicket-taker is Ayush Shukla, with 3 wickets. The team showed strength by defeating Oman by 41 runs in a previous match, scoring 121/8 in 20 overs.

Ground statistics and performance predictions

The average first-innings total at the Sano International Cricket Ground is 118. Predictions suggest that Pakistan is expected to win the toss, with Maaz Sadaqat as the top run-scorer and Abrar Ahmed as the top wicket-taker. The player of the match could be Maaz Sadaqat.

Match expectations

With Pakistan batting first, a score above 140 is expected, while Hong Kong could reach 85 or more. Pakistan's advantage in the match could be around 60 to 70 runs, according to the predicted handicap. The game will be broadcast live, but geographic restrictions may apply.

What comes next?

The winners will advance to the semifinals, where Pakistan would face the winner of the match between India and Afghanistan. Pakistan aims to consolidate its position and advance in the tournament, while Hong Kong looks to exceed expectations and advance to the next stage.

With information from Cricket World.
